// diagnostic

E2501

`{method}` is not available on a {direction} file handle.

What

`{method}` is not available on a {direction} file handle.

Why

`files.open` returns a read-only handle; `files.create`/`files.append` return a write-only handle. Calling a write method on a reader (or a read method on a writer) is a type error.

Fix

Use the correct handle type for the operation: `files.open` to read, `files.create`/`files.append` to write.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2501: tests/ui/e2501_bad_handle_method.stderr.

Error [jet.FileHandleDirectionMismatch]: `write_line` is not available on a read-only file handle
  --> tests/ui/e2501_bad_handle_method.jet:6:7
    |
  6 |     h.write_line("hello")
    |       ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `files.open` returns a read-only handle; it can only read lines or bytes
 Fix: Use `files.create` or `files.append` to get a writable handle
